source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-14

procedures.title: Spherical joint lube fittings: replace
steps: To replace just a fitting, a standard threaded fitting may be used.
New spherical joint assemblies come without a fitting: screw a self-threading fitting into the untapped hole provided.
notes: Factory joints use special self-threading lube fittings.
